description: Deep subpaths of declared packages are fine; deep subpaths of undeclared packages are not.
groundTruth: `@scope/known/sub` resolves to declared `@scope/known`; the other two specifiers resolve to undeclared packages.

expected.reason: `@other/unknown` is the package behind `@other/unknown/sub` and is not declared.
`plain-unknown` is the package behind `plain-unknown/deep/path` and is not declared.
